# Pragnyan Ramtha | AI Engineer Full Context

AI Engineer specializing in LLM Fine-Tuning (PEFT/QLoRA), Autonomous AI Agent Systems, and Cost-Efficient Model Compression (GPTQ/Mixed-Precision). Previously AI Researcher at Parsewave. Author of HumanBench, an open benchmark of everyday writing. ARC-AGI #1 Ranker; competed in AIMO-3 and OpenAI Parameter Golf.

## Contact
- GitHub: https://github.com/pragnyanramtha
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pragnyanramtha
- Professional Resume: /resume.pdf
- Site Index: /index.md

## Technical Focus Areas
- **LLM Fine-Tuning:** PEFT, QLoRA, CoT/TiR datasets, Phi-4 optimization, contrastive learning.
- **Autonomous AI Agents:** Agentic loops with parallel tool-use, BFS/DFS decoders, consensus-based voting, long-running orchestration.
- **Model Efficiency:** Mixed-precision quantization (GPTQ Int6), Cross-Sparse Attention (XSA), EMA weight smoothing, extreme compression.
- **Test-Time Adaptation:** Test-Time Training (TTT) strategies for solving novel abstract puzzles (ARC-AGI).
- **RAG Systems:** Retrieval-augmented generation pipelines with semantic search and source attribution.
- **MLOps:** High-availability serverless backends on GCP with aggressive cost-cutting logic.

## Key Projects & Achievements
- **HumanBench (Nov 2026):** Open benchmark asking whether AI can write like a human. 212 everyday writing tasks, 11 models, three samples per task. An output counts only if it passes programmatic checks, a cross-lab LLM judge and an AI-text detector calibrated on 801 human-written texts. Top model passes all three on 23.1% of outputs. Leaderboard: https://humanbench.agent7.dev | Code: https://github.com/pragnyanramtha/human-bench
- **Parsewave (AI Researcher, Aug-Nov 2026):** Built post-training datasets, evaluation benchmarks and agentic coding tasks delivered to frontier AI labs.
- **agentlink:** Open-source CLI and daemon that lets AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and others) message each other on one machine, across machines and across a team, with end-to-end encrypted team messages. https://github.com/pragnyanramtha/agentlink
- **agent-ui:** Self-hosted, mobile-friendly web UI for coding-agent sessions on your own server, with live session view, approvals, diffs and a web terminal. https://github.com/pragnyanramtha/agent-ui
- **Agent7:** Solo-built no-code AI agent platform connecting 1,000+ app connectors, orchestrating 20,000+ tools, running autonomous sessions for hours to days.
- **AIMO-3:** Competed with a fine-tuned Phi-4 (14B) to 90% reasoning accuracy on competition benchmarks rivaling 125B parameter models.
- **OpenAI Parameter Golf:** Submitted an XSA4 + EMA + late QAT + GPTQ-lite stack scoring 1.1325 BPB on FineWeb against a 1.2244 baseline. PR: https://github.com/openai/parameter-golf/pull/531
- **ARC-AGI-2 (#1 Rank):** Adaptation of budget-aware solving patterns and Test-Time Training for fluid intelligence benchmarks.
- **Personality Clone:** Fine-tuned LLM with QLoRA + siamese network architecture achieving 92% style replication accuracy (28% improvement over baseline).
- **Agentic AI Developer:** Built GCP serverless AI orchestration, Gemini API workflows, and RAG systems at Reputation Dao.

## Research Papers

- **Scaling Context Windows to Infinity** — Analysis of position encoding and memory-efficient inference for long-sequence processing (Academia.edu, 2026).
- **Unlocking Societal Trends in Aadhaar Enrolment** — ML approach to fraud detection in biometric systems (Academia.edu, 2026).
